question: In March 2019, the Indian Open international snooker tournament, under the aegis of the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association, was held at Kochi in Kerala. Who won the final of this tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Matthew Selt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Matthew Selt** claimed his first-ever ranking title at the 2019 Indian Open. He defeated Lyu Haotian 5-3 in the final held in Kochi, Kerala.
 
• He also made it to the quarterfinals of the 2021 Turkish Masters and several other ranking events.
 
• Selt is known for his solid,** methodical style of play** and his ability to perform well under pressure in ranking events.
 
• He also made it to the **quarterfinals of the 2021 **Turkish Masters and several other ranking events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anthony Hamilton**'s Nickname: **"The Sheriff of Pottingham,"** because he hails from Nottingham.

• **Lyu Haotian** reached the final of the Indian Open 2019 but was defeated by Matthew Selt 5–3.
